## About
Q & E is an engine and machine shop at 1140 N Kraemer Blvd in Anaheim. Customers have brought us motorcycle engines for a valve job and cylinder bore, parts to be resleeved, and damaged threads for repair with Time-Serts.
We also take on the small, odd jobs. One customer needed a socket turned down on the lathe to fit a tight spot, and we did it while he waited.
We hold a 4 star Google rating from 45 reviews. Stop by or give us a call to talk through your project.

## Services
- Valve job and cylinder bore: Valve and cylinder work, including motorcycle engines.
- Lathe work: Small one-off machining jobs. One reviewer had a socket turned down on the lathe to fit a tight spot.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on motorcycle engines?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in a motorcycle engine for a valve job and cylinder bore.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: We are open Saturday from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM and closed Sunday.

Q: Can you repair stripped threads?
A: Yes. One reviewer had the oil pan drain plug threads on his car repaired with Time-Serts.

## What customers say
- "Had a 15 mm socket that wouldn't quite clear two rocker arms to reach a nut holding the valvetrain support bar. Did it right in front of me for $25, and now it fits like a glove. Thank you, Q&E!" (Aidan Miller, 5/5)
